about: Teeth (H1 combat teeth, docs/team/hook/H1_combat_teeth.md): what a table night's tier asks of a human, on top of the night's own curves; numbers described in logic/Content/Teeth.cs. Measured with the harness's late hands: `arena --bot plain,deft,human,careless`, then tools/balance/danger.py. A tier with no entry is as it was. Tier 1, round 1 (H1, 3 Nov; 128 nights a bot at 12 min, kit on): fodder fall to 3 of her hits and champions to 9 (ember 0-10); the late human ends at 31% of life at its lowest and falls 15%, careless 20%, the deft hands win 96%; the boss comes at 10:00 and takes about 2:15.
